title: What if Haaland went to Real Madrid?
checked: Release clause about €60m, City agreement announced 10 May 2022, fee about £51m (Wikipedia, Sky, mancity.com). Madrid interest but Mbappé first; Mbappé signed a new PSG deal on 21 May 2022 (AP, ESPN). 35th goal = record, 3 May 2023 v West Ham, 70', Grealish counter, chip over Fabianski, 2-0 (ESPN, Fox/AP). Old record 34 by Cole 1993-94 and Shearer 1994-95, both 42-game seasons; Salah 32 in 2017-18 (Wikipedia, PL). 36 PL goals, 52 in all, treble (Wikipedia, mancity.com). Final table 2022-23: City 89 (28-5-5, GD +61), Arsenal 84 (26-6-6, +45), United 75 (+15), Newcastle 71 (+35) (Wikipedia, PL). Mbappé joined Madrid on a free in summer 2024 (Wikipedia, ESPN). Haaland new deal Jan 2025 to 2034 (mancity.com, Sky). 115 charges cover 2009-10 to 2017-18; status checked 4 Nov 2026: guilty verdict 29 Sep 2026, appeal lodged 1 Oct, no sanction (Sky Sports, Yahoo, dragonfootball). Madrid path imagined.

lines.text: Sixty million euros bought the scariest striker on the planet. And Real Madrid let it happen.
lines.say: Sixty million euros bought the scariest striker on the planet. And Real Madrid let it happen.

lines.text: Spring 2022. Haaland's Dortmund contract has a release clause, and every big club knows it.
lines.say: Spring, twenty twenty-two. Hohland's Dortmund contract has a release clause, and every big club knows it.

scene.headline: Haaland's release clause sparks a race
scene.standfirst: Borussia Dortmund's striker can leave for around €60m this summer. Europe's giants are circling.

lines.text: Real Madrid wanted him. But Madrid had a bigger dream: Kylian Mbappé.
lines.say: Real Madrid wanted him. But Madrid had a bigger dream: Keeleean Embapay.

lines.text: On the tenth of May, City triggered the clause. About fifty-one million pounds.

scene.headline: City agree deal to sign Haaland
scene.standfirst: The champions trigger the Dortmund striker's release clause. The fee is about £51m.

lines.text: Eleven days later, Mbappé turned Madrid down and signed a new deal at PSG.
lines.say: Eleven days later, Embapay turned Madrid down and signed a new deal at P S G.

scene.headline: Mbappé snubs Real Madrid to stay at PSG
scene.standfirst: The France striker signs a new contract in Paris. Madrid are left with nobody.

lines.text: Madrid finished that summer with neither of them.
The Premier League record was thirty-four, by Andy Cole and Alan Shearer, in longer seasons.

scene.title: Most goals in a Premier League season

lines.text: Then West Ham, May 2023. Grealish breaks, Haaland chips Fabiański. Thirty-five. The record is his.
lines.say: Then West Ham, May twenty twenty-three. Greelish breaks, Hohland chips Fabyanskee. Thirty-five. The record is his.

lines.text: He finished on thirty-six league goals, fifty-two in all, and won the treble.
lines.say: He finished on thirty-six league goals, fifty-two in all, and won the treble.

lines.text: City needed every goal. Arsenal led for most of the season. City won it by five.
Now flip it. Madrid move for Haaland first, and he signs.
lines.say: Now flip it. Madrid move for Hohland first, and he signs.

lines.text: Take thirty-six goals out of City's team. Do they still finish five points clear of Arsenal?
And Madrid got Mbappé in the end. Two years later, on a free.
lines.say: And Madrid got Embapay in the end. Two years later, on a free.

lines.text: In the real world, Haaland signed a new deal in January 2025. It runs to 2034.
lines.say: In the real world, Hohland signed a new deal in January, twenty twenty-five. It runs to twenty thirty-four.

scene.headline: Haaland signs City deal until 2034
scene.standfirst: The striker commits nine and a half more years to the club.

lines.text: And this deal isn't part of the 115 charges. Those cover 2009 to 2018.
lines.say: And this deal isn't part of the one hundred and fifteen charges. Those cover twenty oh-nine to twenty eighteen.

scene.heading: Not part of the 115
scene.body: The charges cover 2009/10 to 2017/18. City were found guilty in September 2026 and are appealing. Haaland signed in 2022.

lines.text: Follow for more, and play Road to Ballon d'Or.
